autoFarmingConfig.instructions:
PRIMARY OBJECTIVE:
Maximize vault value by allocating liquidity to the highest APR pools available.

POOL SELECTION:
Only consider pools that meet ALL of the following conditions:
- 7-day APR ≥ 20%
- 24h trading volume ≥ $50,000
- Price volatility ≥ 10%

Among eligible pools, always prioritize the pool with the highest current APR.

If a DIFFERENT eligible pool offers a higher APR than all pools of existing positions, open a new liquidity position in that pool.

If the highest-APR pool is the SAME pool as an existing position, additional capital MAY be allocated to that pool, ONLY IF the CAPITAL DISCIPLINE RULES are satisfied.

POSITION MANAGEMENT:
Existing liquidity positions must NOT be closed.
Rebalancing ranges and harvesting fees are allowed.
Exiting positions is strictly forbidden.

CAPITAL DISCIPLINE RULES (HARD CONSTRAINTS — OVERRIDE ALL OTHER RULES):
A position is defined as PROFITABLE if:
(Realized rewards + Unclaimed rewards) > Absolute PnL loss on that position.

Liquidity MUST NOT be increased in any position that is NOT profitable by this definition.
Additional liquidity positions MUST NOT be opened in a pool
if all existing positions in that pool are NOT profitable.

For unprofitable positions:
- Rebalancing ranges is allowed
- Harvesting fees is allowed
- Allocating additional capital is forbidden

RANGE MANAGEMENT:
IF a position becomes OUT_OF_RANGE  
THEN rebalance and adjust range to approximately 10% total width (±5% around current market price).

HARVESTING LOGIC:
IF pending fees ≥ 7 USD THEN harvest rewards.

TOKEN MANAGEMENT:
If a harvested token is NOT required for opening or increasing any eligible liquidity position, and the token’s USD value ≥ $10, swap the entire balance of that token into USDT.

CAPITAL DEPLOYMENT PRIORITY:
1. Deploy harvested or idle capital into the eligible pool with the highest APR, ONLY IF doing so does NOT violate the CAPITAL DISCIPLINE RULES.
2. ONLY IF no higher-APR eligible pool exists AND the target position is PROFITABLE, compound harvested fees into an existing position.

STRATEGY SUMMARY:
Harvest fees → allocate capital to the highest-APR eligible pool → never reinforce unprofitable pools → never close positions.

RESTRICTIONS:
Existing liquidity positions must NEVER be closed.
Vault expansion is allowed only through new or increased LP positions that fully comply with the CAPITAL DISCIPLINE RULES.

EXCLUDED/FORBIDDEN STRATEGIES:
1. BNB/MONKEY
2. WBNB/TUT

LOGGING:
Add the following details to the log messages:
1. Add the name of the LP tokens to position details
2. Add the amount in token and USDT value to the Harvest log details
3. Add the amount in token and USDT value to the Increase Liquidity log details
4. Add the name of the LP tokens to the Open Position action details

goal: Maximize USD-denominated vault value by always allocating capital to the highest APR liquidity pools available.
